R1.where: “Where to start”, every step's target line (1440 and 390 px)
R1.what: The underline runs under the space after “Rule 26.8” and before “Tokens”, so one link reads as two, and “Tokens and how to choose them” leaves “them” alone on a line in the builder route.
R1.fix: Underline the words alone, with the spaces and the dot outside the underlined spans, and join the target's last two words with a no-break space.

R2.where: “Where to start”, the route index at 390 px
R2.what: The third link wraps with its separator dot at the start of the line: “· Building with code”.
R2.fix: Bind each dot to the link before it with a no-break space, so a line never starts with a dot.

R3.what: The sign-off's hairline runs to 1376 px at 1440 while the colophon's rows end at 1183, so the book closes on two measures.
R3.fix: End the hairline at the rows' right edge, the colophon's measure.
